subject: Decision Making
title: Explainable AI
description: A quick win: understand Explainable AI.

hook.text: A loan application is rejected. The applicant asks why. The bank says the algorithm decided. No one can explain how.

buildup.text: Deep learning models can contain billions of parameters. Even the engineers who built them cannot explain individual.

discovery.text: Explainable AI, or XAI, creates models that can show their reasoning.

twist.text: The EU's GDPR includes a right to explanation. Citizens can demand to know how automated decisions about them were made.

climax.text: Explainability trades off with accuracy. The most accurate models are the hardest to explain.

punchline.text: Why was I rejected? The algorithm cannot say. Explainable AI must fix this.

quiz.question: Why is explainable AI important?
options: People have the right to understand how automated decisions affecting them are made
